Life Insurance professional here, and basis the chatter within the company and my friends in other Life insurance companies here are some suggestions.

1. Buy a good flat term cover with critical illness between 23rd to 30th sep. Companies will try to boost their H1 closures so might not increase premiums right now. Cover should be minimum of 15 times your ctc.

2. Opt for regular pay or pay till your retirement age. Dont go for short pay options that the agent might push. Also, take cover only till the age of 70 or 75 at max. Any cover more than that will be highly expensive.

3. Direct ULIPs upto 2.50 lakh (from the website, not agent) will now become more attractive as there will be just two charges: Fund management charge & Mortality charge. Previously GST made these plans a stupid decision against Mutual funds. Now, with tax free maturity & zero GST, this becomes a good tool for child plan.

4. Avoid everything else from the life insurance company apart from these two options.

Now for health insurance and general insurance, someone from you all can share your views. Will help me as well😊
